The Sr8Zr4N8 structure (reduced formula Sr2ZrN2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 20 atoms in the unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. The neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and edge sharing between tetrahedral N, between trigonal bipyramidal N, and between Sr tetrahedra.
